_comment: File: composer.json — PHP dependency definitions for GlobeTrek Adventures
_purpose: Declares all Composer-managed PHP libraries used by the application
_usage: Run 'composer install' to install all dependencies into the vendor/ directory
_lock_file: composer.lock locks dependency versions for consistent deployments

require._dompdf_purpose: PDF generation library — used for exporting sales reports and customer reports as PDF files
require._phpmailer_purpose: Email sending library — used for sending HTML emails via Gmail SMTP
require._phpspreadsheet_purpose: Excel spreadsheet library — used for exporting sales reports as XLSX files
require._safe_purpose: Type-safe PHP function wrappers — provides exceptions instead of null/false returns
require._safe_used_by: Used throughout the codebase for safer PHP function calls
